assets.affordance: must not form a complete playable diamond at review scale

assets.clearance: face center, emergence approach, overlays, and contact region remain exposed

palette_policy.note: Candidate colors are original shell-lime, chalk, bleached timber, canvas, ceramic, service-metal, umber, and dark separators; no live-site swatches are copied.

generation.reference_policy: Only Agent D owner-approved generated concepts are used as identity references.
generation.post_generation: deterministic keying, connected-component crop, nearest resample, palette quantization without dither, hard alpha, geometry/pivot/reserved-color QA
